name: prompt-639
image_vibe: Dark dreamy vintage night, windy motion blur, soft low-fi film atmosphere
image_purpose: Create an atmospheric moving-car portrait with authentic nighttime blur and analog mood.

prompt.project_info: A dark dreamy vintage portrait photographed from a moving car at night.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult face reference must be preserved without altering facial details or head positioning. The subject has long brown wavy hair moving in the wind and wears a white off-shoulder knitted top with opaque coverage, leaning her back out of the car window in a safe stylized editorial pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Close portrait from the car window, head positioning unchanged, windblown hair, dark nighttime surroundings, and soft directional motion blur.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low ambient night light, dreamy haze, subdued highlights, wind movement, and blurred vintage-night atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Vintage film look, soft focus, motion blur, realistic hair movement and fabric texture, low-light grain, cinematic composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a dark dreamy blurry vintage-night portrait using the approved adult face reference without changing facial details or head positioning. The subject leans her back out of a car window, with long brown wavy hair blowing in the wind, wearing a white off-shoulder knitted top with opaque coverage. Use low ambient night light, soft focus, gentle motion blur, subtle haze, analog film grain, and an atmospheric cinematic composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent knit, exposed underwear, nudity, unsafe driving behavior, altered face, inconsistent likeness, plastic skin, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: approved adult face reference
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult facial details and head positioning; do not substitute a celebrity or public-figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Face reference is required. Preserve the off-shoulder knit top, car-window framing, windblown hair, and dark vintage blur; keep the knit opaque and the scene clearly editorial and safely staged.

changes: Clarified approved adult face reference and opaque knit coverage.
Added safe-staging and age exclusions while preserving the car-window concept.
